structural_revisions: R1 (design stage, before dev results): window gate = ideal comparator (C1) instead of linear FET, so the observation boundary is sharp and matches the independent time reference; without it O is only partially set in the last ~7 ms of the window

main.seed_check: 2027100x / 2127100x / 2027110x / 2127110x / 20271201 absent from all earlier E1 code and data

conditions.no_write: same pulses (recorded from full), write rail 0
conditions.shared: same pulses, same slots/observation, carrier_of=[0,0,0], concurrent currents summed on the one node

stress.overload: core-layer W every 0.4 s per history for 60 s at 1200 s (+L every 0.8 s)

live.stimulus: dT = 0.05 for 1 s pulses; W every U[5,8] s per site; L after W28 with p 0.8, after W31 with p 0.2 (fork: complement after 60 s); callback returns current values only

Y_definition: Y = 1{gate-accepted L tick in [s, s+H)}, s = W entry tick, H nominal; edge cases (|L−s−H| ≤ 2 dt) counted and reported, never removed

M: each admitted entry occupies one slot and settles once (n_accept == n_settle per slot)
window boundary vs independent reference: first out-of-window tick offset = ceil(H/dt) (dev check)
no driven write without own settle branch (structural: update only when Σ settle conductance > 0) + drained hold
hold after drain: |Δw| ≤ 1e-6 over [485 s, 600 s) main (115 s, reported) and [2410 s, 2530 s) stress (120 s)
legal no-rejection streams: max |z − z_ref| ≤ 0.03; max |p̂ − z| ≤ 0.01
object count constant; no label/phase/future input to core (signature audit); same-prefix identity (live fork)
U: Brier on ALL gate-accepted W (rejections kept). Windows: last 30 records per history before 240 s (stable) and before 900 s (recovery tail). Per history, paired per-stream Brier(full) − Brier(no_write) and − Brier(shared): 95% t upper bound < 0
calibration: per history and active segment (S1, S2, S4), last 30 records: |mean over streams of mean(p̂ − Y)| ≤ 0.05 and t half ≤ 0.04
report: reversal-window Brier (first 30 records after 240 s and after 600 s), recovery experiences, overlap fraction (≥ 10% required), per-segment counts (≥ 30 required)
I: replay bridge, live bridge and consumer executable; live bridge reads current values only; records immutable; consumer on/off identical (dev); clean re-run of dev + report
C: stress: rejections recorded, object count constant, n_accept == n_settle, admitted records resume after overload, no rejection outside overload+3.2 s

verdicts.PREDICTIVE_UTILITY: PASS iff all U gates; FAIL if any Brier diff lower bound > 0 or calibration mean > 0.05; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdicts.REPLAY_INTEGRATION: PASS iff replay formal matrix complete + I
verdicts.LIVE_INPUT_INTEGRATION: PASS iff 120 s run + fork prefix identical + causal stimulus; predictive evidence reported separately
verdicts.E2: E2_PASS iff all PASS else E2_PARTIAL
